title: lightning-round-org-update-nov-30-2026
content:
TL;DR:
Quick, focused notes from the abbreviated org update on 2026-11-30 (30 min). Goal was to surface cross-team blockers ahead of end-of-quarter rollouts and to sync on two emergent reliability signals.

Attendees:
- Aisha Patel (obs lead)
- Marcus Nguyen (serving runtime)
- Lina Chen (platform infra)
- Tomás Rivera (SRE)
- ~25 engineers live + recording

Agenda (30m):
1) Two-minute lightning updates from each subteam (observability, agent tracing, runtime metrics)
2) Short dive: KV-cache miss spike and early mitigation
3) Roadmap spotlight: rollout schedule for Canary X (dedicated inference pools)
4) Ask corner + action items

Highlights / Notes:
- Observability: new ingestion sampler has shipped to staging (Marcus + Lina). Early numbers: 18% reduction in storage growth for low-priority traces; CPU overhead on capture side ~0.4% p50. Plan: ramp to 50% traffic next week, watch tail latency.
- Agent tracing: experimental tag propagation added; still hashing across 2% of requests. Root cause appears to be older SDK clients not injecting trace header. Ops plan: backfill with proxy injection for legacy routes.
- Runtime metrics: KV-cache miss spike on 11/29 (peak 3h window). Correlated with a model variant rollout to canary nodes (model-v2-quant). Miss reason: shard rebalance + cold-warm eviction policy interacting with request routing.

Incident mini-postmortem (KV-cache miss spike):
- Symptom: 30% P95 token latency increase for short-seq generation on canary pool, lasted ~3 hours.
- Root cause hypothesis: simultaneous canary rollout + autoscaler-induced pod churn caused repeated cache invalidations; policy had aggressive ttl and no warmup.
- Immediate mitigation: (Tomás) throttled canary rollout, pinned model-v2-quant to a stable subset, increased warmup window to 15m.
- Monitoring actions: add a canary-specific cache hit-rate dashboard and an alert when hit-rate delta >10% vs baseline. Owner: Marcus (obs). ETA: 2026-12-03.

Metrics snapshot (live at meeting):
- Platform-wide request rate: 220k RPS (stable)
- Observability ingestion: 12 TB/day (down from 14 TB/day last week after sampler)
- Average KV cache hit-rate (prod, seq<64): 87% (baseline 93%)
- P95 latency (text-gen): 240 ms (target 200 ms) — note: canary affected regions only

Roadmap & Rollouts:
- Canary X (dedicated inference pools for enterprise customers): initial phase paused until cache hit-rate is stable. New tentative canary resume date: 2026-12-06.
- Streaming v2: API contract review done; backward-compatible change scheduled for 2027-01-05. Integration tests written by devex team.
- Observability retention tiers: proposal out for review (Lina). Target decision before EOY for billing impact modeling.

Cross-team asks (quick wins / blockers):
- Serving-runtime: provide a short note on routing policy change that triggered rebalance (due EOD 2026-12-01). Owner: Marcus.
- DevEx: add SDK note to alert customers about missing trace headers for pre-2025 clients; small patch to auto-inject headers in proxy. Owner: Lina.
- SRE: create alert runbook for sudden KV-cache miss rate regression. Owner: Tomás.

Action items (concrete):
1) Add canary cache hit-rate dashboard and alert (Marcus) — due 2026-12-03.
2) Rollback plan doc for canary pool rollouts (Serving Runtime) — draft due 2026-12-02 (PR: linked_artifacts).
3) Proxy injection patch for legacy SDKs (Platform infra) — ship to staging 2026-12-04.
4) Hold a 1-hour post-mortem deep dive if hit-rate does not recover by 2026-12-05 (Aisha to coordinate).

Parking lot / follow-ups:
- Evaluate impact of sampler on query-pattern analytics; may need a low-latency fallback path for anomaly detection.
- Discuss whether warmup should be automated during rollouts (policy + code changes) — bring into next sprint planning.

Standup highlights (excerpted from week):
- Observability: finishing ingestion sampler docs; onboarding two new SREs next week.
- Serving-runtime: perf micro-optimizations for short-seq attention kernel landed in branch; perf regression tests added.
- Platform: proxy auto-injector MVP in review.

Risks / blockers:
- If cache hit-rate remains <90% for more than 48 hours, customer-facing latency SLOs for small-sequence generation are at risk for canary customers. Engineering/Customer Success alignment required for rollback comms.
- Hiring: 2-week delay in hiring for senior SRE will shift some on-call burden; leveraging contractors temporarily.

Next org touchpoint:
- Follow-up lightning sync: 2026-12-03 09:30 PT (15 minutes) to check canary hit-rate and actions.
- Full engineering all-hands scheduled 2026-12-14 (extended agenda to include Q4 metrics and incident themes).

Notes to self (Aisha):
- Capture screenshots of dashboard deltas and add to confluence page for the incident.
- Remind product to delay Canary X marketing comms until stability confirmed.

End of notes.

Minutes recorded by: Aisha Patel
Status: draft -> in_review (share with serving-runtime and platform infra leads for signoff)
